name: Lolotte
message: 「That means no one has found out, right? Phew... What a relief~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, everyone would probably be shocked if they knew.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-That would be terrible! What happened today is a secret just between the two of us\s04」
Lolotte closes her eyes and puckers her lips. Begging for a kiss again.

name: Lolotte
message: 「You can treat me like a child... as long as you kiss me」
No matter how many times we kiss, it still makes me bashful.
Even if we tried to act a little grown-up, we were still just kids.
